notes.title: Update the patch description on June 19th.
notes.content:
Fixed some problems that might cause the interface to get stuck.
I'm sorry that there were some problems in the last update, which affected the game experience of players.
If dear players encounter any problems in the game, please come to the discussion forum to post feedback. We see that the feedback in the discussion forum will solve the problem quickly.
Thank you for your patience and support.

notes.title: The difficulty of the game has dropped greatly.
notes.content: [p][/p][p]1. Add a fishing game, which is triggered in the store. It is a very simple game, which is very suitable for players who like leisure and relaxation.[/p][p]2. Greatly reduce the difficulty of the courier game, and increase the protection of deposit gold coins, and no longer deduct the deposit gold coins.[/p][p]3. The prize amount of the big turntable game was modified, which effectively avoided the loss of gold coins.[/p][p]4. Many feedback questions and optimization suggestions from players have been modified.[/p]

notes.title: June 3 patch update instructions
notes.content:
1. The display window size of some resolutions does not match, and the problem that the full screen cannot display the complete picture has been solved.
2. The jigsaw interface, when the jigsaw puzzle, there are gaps that have been solved.
3. Express deposit gold coins are not enough tips, plus tips of less than 3,000 gold coins.
4. Improve the mathematical probability of the big turntable, and reduce the difficulty of low-priced express orders with a unit price of 500 or 800.
After the courier earns 3000, the courier bill with difficulty above 1000 will be issued.
5. Set the function of automatic archiving when you return to town to avoid the loss of game data.
6. The super lucky achievement bug has been solved
7. The difficulty of the first and second customers in the bar game is reduced.

notes.title: Emergency update
notes.content: Fixed a major bug caused by the failure to control the progress bar with the mouse in cg interface due to the different frame rates of some computers.

notes.title: Answers to some questions in the game
notes.content:
1. For some players with different computer configurations and different frame rates, the progress bar hardly fluctuates when the player controls the climax progress bar with the mouse in cg. We have released an emergency update. We apologize for the impact on the player's game experience, and thank the players for their patience.

2. Regarding the difficulty of making money from small games, we plan to add a fishing system in the next upgraded version, so that players can get gold coins and clue fragments in a more leisure way.

3. Regarding the problem that the difficulty of the mini-game was too high before, we have updated and revised it to reduce the difficulty of the low-priced express order, improve the mathematical probability of the big turntable mini-game, and reduce the difficulty of the first two customers of the bar mini-game.

4. We have updated the screen adaptation to solve the problem that the game display is incomplete under the size of some players' monitors.

5. With regard to the problem that players generally reported before that the game data is easy to be lost due to the lack of automatic archiving, we have added the function of automatically archiving when we return to the town.

notes.title: May 29th patch description
notes.content:
1. Fixed a bug that failed to initialize the task system when starting the game under some computer models.
2. Fixed some flashback bugs.
3. Fixed the confusion of the conditions for the achievement of the richest man.

Thank you for your feedback on our game. I wish you a happy game.
